sites.downstream: POST request JSON prompt -> model.stream(prompt) -> LangChainAdapter.toDataStreamResponse(stream) at workflow.ts:17 -> HTTP response
sites.reason: Unrestricted streaming text completion has no enumerated decision outputs. Replacing it with typed judgments would change the HTTP response contract. Input length is unrestricted and no untrusted-input mitigation is present.

options.benefit: Preserves all streaming response semantics and diagnostics; cost and latency remain unchanged because no inference is replaced.
options.risk: No new migration risk; existing provider and input risks remain.
